title: h5read
summary: Read dense numeric, logical, or string datasets from an HDF5 file.

gpu_support.notes: HDF5 parsing is host file I/O; GPU inputs are gathered at the builtin boundary.

description: `h5read(filename, dataset)` reads dense HDF5 datasets, with optional one-based `start`, `count`, and `stride` selections.
behaviors: Supports dense numeric, logical, and variable-length string datasets.
Unsupported compound/object/reference types raise deterministic unsupported-type errors.
